- **[Gym formats to rotate](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-gym-rotation-formats)** (idea): Rotate: "Chest day in 30 seconds" vlog (B-roll + 3–4 exercises with sets×reps on screen), "3 exercises for [muscle]" list, monthly progress series (same angle and light), gym humour/POV, diary voice-over, high-protein Indian meals.

- **[Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion)** (edit): Our edit blueprint sets cut rules (on the beat or on motion) and travel uses a wide → close-up rhythm. Khandala cut every 1.5 s, which lands on 80 and 120 BPM beats (2 or 3 beats per shot), so music could be added later.
- **[Trending audio only when it fits](../topics/sound.md#sound-trending-audio-fit)** (sound): Trending audio boosts discovery when it fits the format: energetic for gym transformations, nostalgic acoustic for travel recaps, spoken for skits; original voice-over builds connection.
- **[Animated number counters](../topics/effects.md#fx-number-counter)** (graphics): Numbers count up on screen (5,220,123 sounds, GitHub stars ticking; Rahul's odometer ₹ counter and an opening price ticker counting to ₹75,000).
- **[Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade)** (edit): Slightly cooler or neutral, higher contrast, clarity/texture up for muscle definition, shadows lifted only a little, distracting signage colours desaturated, subtle vignette.
- **[Grade spec: exact sliders, presets per pillar](../topics/colour.md#colour-slider-spec-safe-bold)** (edit): Our grades list exact slider values with a reason each, a safe and a bold version, an orange-HSL skin check, and one reusable preset per pillar (gym = cool/contrasty, travel = warm/golden).
- **[iPhone 15: frame rates, modes, HDR](../topics/filming.md#film-iphone15-frame-rates)** (film): 4K 30 default; 4K 60 for reps you'll slow; 4K 24 for travel; 240 fps slo-mo for single moments; Action mode handheld; Cinematic mode for B-roll; HDR Video off for heavy grading (no Log/ProRes on the base 15).
- **[Lens choice: 1x low light, 0.5x daylight](../topics/filming.md#film-iphone15-lens-choice)** (film): The 1x 48 MP main lens is best in low light (gym, dusk); 0.5x ultra-wide only in good light; 2x for portraits and tighter muscle shots.
- **[Gym filming: etiquette and side light](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-side-light)** (film): Never film others without consent, don't hog kit, keep the tripod out of walkways; avoid windows and mirrors and let overhead light hit the muscle from the side; film when quieter.
- **[Tripod height changes the story](../topics/filming.md#film-tripod-heights)** (film): Low (41–60 cm) makes lifts look powerful; chest height is neutral; high (120–133 cm, tilted 10–20°) shows symmetry. A light tripod: thickest legs first, column down, legs spread, bag hung on it, out of plate paths.
- **[Solo: record, then walk in](../topics/filming.md#film-solo-start)** (film): Start recording and walk into frame (trim later), or use the 3 s/10 s timer; a watch or Bluetooth remote is faster.
- **[Gym B-roll every session](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-broll)** (film): Walking in, chalk/straps, loading plates, headphones on, pre-workout scoop, pump close-ups, rerack, water sip, mirror check, logging the set.
- **[Two angles per exercise](../topics/filming.md#film-two-angles)** (film): Move the tripod between sets to shoot each exercise from two angles so the edit can cut between them.
- **[Gym angles: chest, shoulders, arms, abs](../topics/filming.md#film-angles-chest)** (film): Bench 45° from the foot end at bench height; presses front 45° slightly low; lateral raises from behind; rear delts top-down; arms side-front close-ups and slow-mo last reps; hanging abs in side profile, floor abs top-down.
- **[Gym angles: legs and back](../topics/filming.md#film-angles-legs)** (film): Squats side-on at hip height; quads low front 45°; RDL from behind; lats from directly behind and slightly low; V-taper high-behind; rows and deadlifts in side profile.
- **[Reply to commenters yourself](../topics/growth.md#growth-reply-personally)** (publish): Make engagement the goal: reply to the people already commenting, yourself (even ~5 a week), reward participation, use niche inside jokes ("bulking season"); teams reply only from a labelled team account.
- **[Seven-repo editing stack](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-seven-tool-stack)** (edit): FFmpeg (every cut, mix, render), faster-whisper (word timing), Whisper, yt-dlp (download sources), OpenCV + contrib CSRT tracker (follow the speaker in a 9:16 crop), Puppeteer (render HTML captions), HyperFrames (agent-built motion graphics).
- **[Before/after slider reveals the grade](../topics/effects.md#l10-grade-slider-reveal)** (edit): The source shows a warm look switched on, then a vertical slider wipes across to take it off: a before/after reveal. Chandler: FFmpeg makes the colour change, Remotion the slider.
- **[Promise hook: daily habit, three payoffs](../topics/hooks.md#l11-promise-hook)** (script): Template: "If you [do B] every single day, you're going to [X], [Y] and [Z]". A tiny repeatable habit, 'every single day', then three concrete outcomes (rule of three). Each outcome is another reason to care. Reel's example: "If you take creatine every single day, you're going to build more muscle, recover faster, and get way more out of all the hard work that you're putting in in the gym" (pill 28M, the reel's biggest example).

## Memes (45)

- **Vine boom**: Realisation, shock, 'did he really just say that'. The universal punchline marker. Timing: Transient lands ON the reaction/punchline frame (frame 0 of the face or text). Freeze or hold 8-12 frames (0.27-0.4 s) at 30 fps, then cut. Never let it run under speech.
- **Bruh**: Disappointment at something dumb (yours or someone else's). Timing: Land 3-6 frames AFTER the fail frame so the fail reads first; hold a freeze 12-15 frames.
- **Metal pipe falling**: Absurd sudden fail; something falling that should not; chaos. Timing: Transient exactly on the contact frame; let the ring play over 20-30 frames of freeze or slow-mo.
- **Sad violin / world's smallest violin**: Mock sympathy; first-world problem. Timing: Start on the 'sad' frame, duck everything else -12 dB, cut the violin hard at the next scene cut.
- **Record scratch + freeze ('Yep, that's me')**: Cold-open: start at the chaotic climax, then flash back. Timing: Scratch ends on the freeze frame; music must stop on the same frame. Hold freeze 45-60 frames for the VO line, then hard cut to 'earlier' card.
- **Phonk / Gigachad edit**: Aura, dominance, 'he's him'. Gym transformation and gaming highlight edits. Timing: Cut every 1/2 beat in the build, then on the drop: hard cut to the hero shot exactly on the first kick; flash 1 frame; slow-mo after.
- **Aura farming / aura points**: +1000 aura: calm flex, composure under pressure. '-500 aura' for a fail. Timing: Text '+1000 aura' pops on the downbeat (4-frame scale-in with overshoot); hold until next bar.
- **'Stay hard' (David Goggins)**: Discipline, no excuses; the grind. Timing: Put the line at the START of the hardest rep or set (the grimace frame), not after. Music dips -10 dB for the line.
- **'Yeah buddy! Light weight baby!' (Ronnie Coleman)**: Ironic hype on a heavy (or very light) lift. Timing: 'Yeah buddy' lands on the lockout frame of the rep; hold 15-20 frames.
- **Super Saiyan power-up scream**: Gearing up for a max attempt; pre-workout kicking in. Timing: Riser starts ~2 s before the unrack; the scream peaks on the unrack frame; cut to the lift.
- **Training montage (Rocky / Eye of the Tiger)**: Classic progress montage; earnest or ironic. Timing: Cut on every bar (4 beats); the final reveal (before/after) lands on the last brass hit.
- **Zyzz / aesthetics hardstyle**: 'We're all gonna make it' aesthetic physique culture. Timing: Pose/flex changes on every 2nd kick; drop = shirt-off reveal or best-angle shot.
- **'Nah, I'd win' (Gojo, JJK)**: Confidence before facing something huge (a 3-plate deadlift, a boss, a 20-hour layover). Timing: Line ends 4-6 frames before the cut to the challenge; hold a stare 20 frames.
- **'Let him cook'**: Trust the process, he's onto something. Timing: Line drops when someone tries to interrupt; continue the action underneath.
- **GTA 'Wasted'**: Total failure / comic death. Timing: Slow down to 30-40% speed over 6 frames on the fail, desaturate to grey over 15 frames, 'WASTED' text lands at frame ~20 with the sting; hold 45 frames.
- **Minecraft damage 'oof' / Roblox 'oof'**: Small damage, mild pain, 'that hurt'. Timing: On the contact frame (bump, dropped dumbbell on foot, stubbed toe).
- **Mario coin**: Small win, money saved, +1. Timing: On the frame the item/price/rep counter appears; stack on each item in a list (min 6 frames apart).
- **Level-up fanfare (RPG)**: Progress, upgrade, new PR, new gear. Timing: Arpeggio's last note lands on the reveal (new PB on the bar display / new GPU in the case).
- **'Mission failed, we'll get 'em next time'**: Failed attempt, try again tomorrow. Timing: After the fail, black overlay fades in over 10 frames, line plays, text centred.
- **Curb Your Enthusiasm outro ('Frolic')**: Awkward self-own ending; things went wrong in a comedic way. Timing: Freeze on the most awkward frame, music starts on that exact frame, 'Directed by Robert B. Weide' credit fades up ~1 s in; total 3-5 s.
- **SpongeBob time card ('A few moments later')**: Time skip (waiting for a flight, food, a render, a rest timer). Timing: Full-screen card 45-60 frames, hard cut in and out (no transition).
- **'Fahhh'**: Missed it by THAT much: a near-miss, failed rep, missed shot, missed flight. Timing: Shout starts on the miss frame (ball hits post, bar stalls); freeze or slow-mo for the shout (~25 frames).
- **Censor beep**: Covers a swear; also implies a swear for comedy. Timing: Beep exactly spans the word (cut in on its first frame, out on its last); mute the original under it.
- **'Oh no, oh no, oh no no no no no'**: Disaster about to happen; anticipation of a fail. Timing: Start 1-1.5 s BEFORE the fail so the 'no no no' hits on it.
- **'To Be Continued' (Roundabout)**: Cliffhanger right before a disaster. Timing: Song intro starts ~2 s before the fail; freeze on the frame before impact; sepia + 'To Be Continued' arrow slides in from the left over 8 frames.
- **Wilhelm scream**: Cartoonish fall / someone 'dies' (wipeout). Timing: Starts on the frame the person loses balance.
- **Crickets**: Awkward silence, no one laughed, empty gym/no likes. Timing: Cut all music; crickets for 45-60 frames over a static shot.
- **Sad trombone ('wah wah wah waaah')**: Failure, game-show loss. Timing: Last long note on the fail freeze, 60 frames total.
- **Air horn**: Hype, celebration, MLG irony. Timing: Bursts on the beat right after the win, 3 x 8 frames.
- **Dramatic 'dun dun DUNNN'**: Shocking reveal (dramatic chipmunk). Timing: Three hits on three zooms: 100->115->130->150%, 8 frames apart, ending on the reveal.
- **Law & Order 'dun-dun'**: Case closed / scene change with gravity. Timing: Over a black card with a location/time stamp; 2 hits 10 frames apart.
- **Jeopardy 'Think!' music / Kahoot lobby**: Waiting, thinking, loading. Timing: Under a time-lapse of waiting (render bar, queue, rest timer). Cut on any bar line.
- **'Hello darkness, my old friend'**: Sad realisation / back to the grind. Timing: Start on the realisation frame; slow zoom; fade to black.
- **'Yippee!'**: Wholesome tiny win. Timing: On the success frame (bar locks out, package arrives, flight boards).
- **'Sheesh'**: Impressed (a big lift, a clean build). Timing: Start on the reveal, let it run over a slow pan (~1.5 s).
- **'Omae wa mou shindeiru... NANI?!'**: You're already finished; shocked reaction. Timing: Calm line over a stare, 'NANI' on the hard zoom punch.
- **Fake phone notification / message ping**: A text/DM arrives (from your gym bro, your mom, the airline). Timing: Notification banner slides down over 5 frames (ease-out) with the ding on its first frame.
- **Cha-ching cash register**: Money spent/saved, deal found, 'that's expensive'. Timing: On the price-tag reveal frame.
- **Heartbeat tension**: Nerves before a max attempt, landing approach, unboxing price. Timing: Beat interval shrinks toward the moment; silence on the moment itself (1 frame before the action), then hit.
- **Crowd cheer / sitcom applause**: Celebration (ironic for small wins). Timing: Start on the success frame, fade out over 30 frames.
- **Camera shutter 'photo dump'**: Photo dump / still frame / 'snapshot'. Timing: Each still flashes white for 1 frame with the shutter on that frame; 6-10 frames per photo on the beat.
- **VHS rewind 'let's go back'**: Let's rewind to how this started / redo. Timing: Reverse the clip at 3-4x for 15-30 frames with the rewind sound; tape-stop on the last frame before a reset.
- **Sigma stare / 'Rizzler' bass boosted**: Ironic 'sigma male' persona. Timing: Bass hit on the frame the stare begins; zoom 100->120% over 30 frames.
- **'Flawless victory' (Mortal Kombat announcer)**: Total domination with zero damage: perfect set, perfect build, perfect trip. Timing: Line starts on the final frame of the win (last rep locked, last cable tied); freeze 30-45 frames under it.
- **'C-C-C-COMBO BREAKER' (Killer Instinct)**: Someone interrupts your streak/flow (phone call mid-set, mom mid-game). Timing: On the frame of the interruption; 2-3 quick zoom punches on the stutter syllables (6 frames apart).
